ui_bugs.component: MatterTag editor inside merchant order-row Pressable (web)
ui_bugs.issue: The fix (onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true} on the editor View) does nothing on web. In react-native-web 0.21.4, Pressable.onPress is not driven by the responder system. It fires from the native DOM 'click' event in PressResponder.onClick, which calls stopPropagation and onPress on the first ancestor that uses PressResponder (see node_modules/react-native-web/dist/modules/usePressEvents/PressResponder.js:295-321). A click on the TextInput or on blank editor space bubbles to the row Pressable, which runs router.push('/customer/{code}'). The fix probably works on native but not on the web preview or the PWA. Reference: frontend/src/components/MatterTag.tsx:41, frontend/app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:233-252

test_report_links: /tmp/seed52.py (temporary seed and restore helper, not in tests/)
action_items: HIGH: Make the MatterTag editor stop the click from reaching the row. Option A (simplest): change the editor wrapper <View ... onStartShouldSetResponder> in MatterTag.tsx:41 to <Pressable testID={`matter-editor-${stopId}`} onPress={() => {}} accessible={false} style={s.row}>. RN-web's Pressable onClick calls stopPropagation, so the click stops there on web and native alike. Option B (cleaner): restructure the order row in [merchantId].tsx:233 so the row is a View, with a Pressable only around the name, meta and chevron, and MatterTag (and the MAKE PRIORITY button) as siblings outside it. Then retest: clicking matter-input, the input/SAVE gap, the SAVE/✕ gap and the editor edges must keep the URL at /merchant/{mid}.
critical_code_review_comments: On web, the responder-system props (onStartShouldSetResponder) do not stop RN-web Pressable onPress, which is triggered by DOM click. Nested-press isolation needs a nested Pressable or a sibling layout.

The same nesting affects order-priority-{code} (Pressable inside Pressable), which works only because the inner Pressable claims the click. Any blank space around it also goes to the row, as intended for the row itself.

rca_of_issue: react-native-web PressResponder fires onPress from the DOM onClick handler, and that handler stops propagation only at the first PressResponder ancestor. A plain View with onStartShouldSetResponder is not a PressResponder, so clicks on the TextInput or on the View's own blank area bubble up to the order-row Pressable. Mitigation: wrap the editor in a Pressable with a no-op onPress, or move MatterTag out of the row Pressable.
